title: woo qaxmaqaane culte
intro: taswiir tah: rooci meqe sartanat sarteeh, mablak iroh tan gaddittel marrowte. ta numtin amoh numma yaaminem ken gadda sinni duddal geenih yaniinim, numma xayyos raceena qigdu mamaxxaga maacanna. caylale nabiyyih kataysis fanat gexak, ta num rammitleela kulli seeco cineh. asaaku, nanu qaxmeqe gadda keenik ellecabo rabboh arac tekkeh tan muucih kinnaane baxxaqisne.
clues: Anu elle waarem nabiyyih udduruy giddile agat numma fan seece.
Anu doorimte ayyuntih exxak suge, uxih yi sorkocô baxi farmok iroh fakkiimeh.
Dahab kee lakqo faxe yallih amrik muxxi yoo tibbixeh.
yi gaddih kobxiseyna kaxxam baar luk dadalteh too maqar le buttaati maftacitte ugsaanam maduudan.
Anu inni ixxigah taagah yi gadda yoh tomcowweemih kibal liyo.
ellecaboh, yoo kee yi sigmah inkih yan ardi maabitinah yanxuqeh.

arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فِى زِينَتِهِۦ ۖ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا يَـٰلَيْتَ لَنَا مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ قَـٰرُونُ إِنَّهُۥ لَذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍۢ
verse: So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, "Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qārūn. Indeed, he is one of great fortune." (28:79)
